description: This file defines a controller class `ViewMyDetailsController` within the OrangeHRM application. It extends an abstract controller and uses a trait for authentication. The main functionality is to retrieve the authenticated user's employee number and redirect to a personal details viewing page.

classes.name: ViewMyDetailsController
classes.description: Controller handling the display of the current user's personal details via redirection within the HRM system.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving the authenticated user's employee number and redirecting to their personal details page.
